newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SM Prime 1997 net seen at 2.4 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: SM Prime 1997 net seen at 2.4 bln pesos.

text.p: Philippine mall developer SM Prime Holdings Inc expects to post a net income of 2.4 billion pesos this year, Jose Sio, the company treasurer, said on Wednesday.
Last year, the firm's net income was 1.9 billion pesos.
Sio said the company expected a 28 percent increase in revenues this year. Last year, SM Prime posted gross revenues of 3.77 billion pesos.
The official said the anticipated higher earnings this year should be helped by additional income from new space in existing malls as well as the inherent growth of the industry.
The country's largest owner and developer of shopping malls said that it had earmarked three to 3.5 billion pesos in capital expenditures this year.
SM Prime plans to open two new malls this year and another two in 1998. It operates five shopping malls -- four in Metro Manila and one in Cebu in central Philippines.
